reproduce:
from quiverlab import Quiver, GF

Q = Quiver(vertices=[1], arrows={"x": (1, 1)})
A = Q.algebra(relations=['x*x*x'], field=GF(2))
M = A.simple(1, side="right")
M.dimension_vector()
M.radical(), M.top(), M.socle()
M.tau()
